summary: Some people sign a petition without knowing the details, and officials say so.
realLife: A mayor said that people signing a roughly 1,200-name petition were doing so without being fully informed, and pointed to mistakes in its claims.
sources: WSOC-TV, hundreds at Weddington town hearing: https://www.wsoctv.com/news/local/development-debate-brings-hundreds-raucous-weddington-town-meeting/BATFRWXP6NCZFBC2CEMHZBD7IY
inGame: needs: a petition record with a claims field that officials can dispute; the town body's debate is carried by the posted-meeting record

The official corrects one claim at the meeting and the room murmurs.
